title: Spatial Report — 2026-07-16

APP STORE HIGHLIGHTS.title: FitXR Adds 'Journey' Workout Recommendations, Profile Levels & More
APP STORE HIGHLIGHTS.summary: According to UploadVR, FitXR on Meta Quest has rolled out Journey, a personalized workout recommendation system, alongside profile levels and other updates aimed at reducing time spent browsing and increasing time exercising.

AI AND SIMULATED WORLDS.title: Here’s Why Anthropic Is Pushing States to Regulate AI Faster
AI AND SIMULATED WORLDS.summary: Wired reports that Anthropic is urging U.S. states to move faster on AI regulation, with its head of state and local policy arguing that landmark transparency laws the company backed in California and New York last year may already be outdated given the pace of model development.

RESEARCH.title: OccTrack360: 4D Panoptic Occupancy Tracking from Surround-View Fisheye Cameras
RESEARCH.summary: Researchers on arXiv introduce OccTrack360, a benchmark for 4D panoptic occupancy tracking from surround-view fisheye cameras, addressing gaps in existing datasets for long temporal sequences and instance-level voxel tracking relevant to robotics and autonomous driving perception.

OPINION.title: Please Stop Making Me Opt Out of AI
OPINION.summary: In Wired, a columnist argues that companies should stop enabling generative AI features by default and forcing users to opt out, calling for opt-in to become the standard for sensitive AI functionality.

GAMING MARKETPLACE WATCH.title: Open-World Base-Building Action Game StarRupture Coming To Meta Quest 3
GAMING MARKETPLACE WATCH.summary: UploadVR reports that developer Incuvo is bringing StarRupture, an open-world base-building action game, to Meta Quest 3, expanding the headset's roster of large-scale survival and combat titles.

raw_content:
Spatial Report
Week of 2026-07-16

APP STORE HIGHLIGHTS

According to UploadVR, FitXR on Meta Quest has rolled out Journey, a personalized workout recommendation system, alongside profile levels and other updates aimed at reducing time spent browsing and increasing time exercising.

https://www.uploadvr.com/fitxr-journey-workout-recommendations-july-update/

AI AND SIMULATED WORLDS

Wired reports that Anthropic is urging U.S. states to move faster on AI regulation, with its head of state and local policy arguing that landmark transparency laws the company backed in California and New York last year may already be outdated given the pace of model development.

https://www.wired.com/story/why-anthropic-is-pushing-states-to-regulate-ai-faster/

RESEARCH

Researchers on arXiv introduce OccTrack360, a benchmark for 4D panoptic occupancy tracking from surround-view fisheye cameras, addressing gaps in existing datasets for long temporal sequences and instance-level voxel tracking relevant to robotics and autonomous driving perception.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.08521

OPINION

In Wired, a columnist argues that companies should stop enabling generative AI features by default and forcing users to opt out, calling for opt-in to become the standard for sensitive AI functionality.

https://www.wired.com/story/please-stop-making-me-opt-out-of-ai/

GAMING MARKETPLACE WATCH

UploadVR reports that developer Incuvo is bringing StarRupture, an open-world base-building action game, to Meta Quest 3, expanding the headset's roster of large-scale survival and combat titles.

https://www.uploadvr.com/open-world-base-building-action-game-starrupture-coming-to-meta-quest-3/
